Intro.company: Harbin Sonuo Medical Technology Co., Ltd.
Intro.slogan: Focused on high-end medical equipment · Leader in sonodynamic intelligent treatment systems
Intro.paragraph: Located in the Science & Technology Innovation City of Harbin High-tech Zone, Harbin Sonuo Medical Technology Co., Ltd. is a nationally recognized high-tech enterprise and a specialized & innovative SME of Heilongjiang Province. Focused on the R&D, translation and industrialization of high-end medical devices for sonodynamic and transcranial focused ultrasound non-invasive treatment, it is the only enterprise in Heilongjiang with full-chain capabilities in ultrasonic phased-array device R&D, complete system integration and clinical solution implementation. Its core product, the "Arterial Plaque Sonodynamic Therapy System", is the world's first (set) and holds fully independent intellectual property rights.

sdt.title: Arterial Plaque Sonodynamic Therapy System
sdt.subtitle: Plaque Sonodynamic Therapy System
sdt.description: The world's first (set) arterial plaque sonodynamic therapy system (MT-SDT2.0), integrating biomedical technology and big-data AI to precisely remove atherosclerotic plaques through the synergy of ultrasound and sonosensitizers — non-invasive, targeted and highly effective, with fully independent intellectual property in China.

beauty.title: Temperature-control Low-frequency Ultrasound Beauty Device
beauty.subtitle: MC200 Temperature-control Ultrasound Beauty Device
beauty.description: Combining cooling, heating and ultrasound modes in one device, it opens skin absorption channels through low-frequency ultrasound and mechanical vibration to promote penetration of skincare ingredients, delivering a full routine of cleansing, infusion, repair and firming with intelligent temperature control.

bci.title: Brain-Computer Interface · Transcranial Focused Ultrasound
bci.subtitle: tFUS Brain-Computer Interface
bci.description: A self-developed 4-8 channel concentric ring phased-array transducer achieving 1.5mm intracranial focusing precision, providing non-invasive deep neuromodulation for glioma, Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease; under R&D translation.

recognition.title: Ultrasound Plaque Precise Recognition
recognition.subtitle: High-res Ultrasound Imaging
recognition.description: Uses high-resolution diagnostic ultrasound to automatically identify and classify plaques and predict sonodynamic therapy indications, providing individualized treatment parameters and prognosis based on plaque thickness, stenosis rate and blood-flow velocity.

navigation.title: Near-infrared Optical Navigation System
navigation.subtitle: Near-infrared Optical Navigation
navigation.description: A binocular stereo-vision optical navigation system that localizes the diagnostic ultrasound probe in real time with <0.5mm error, precisely guiding the therapy transducer to the plaque position for accurate targeting and tracking.

transducer.title: Uniform Near-field Ultrasound Transducer
transducer.subtitle: Uniform Near-field Transducer
transducer.description: A self-developed therapy transducer that solves the industry problem of near-field intensity disorder, with a beam non-uniformity ratio (BNR) of 2.0-2.5 — surpassing imported brands — providing the fundamental guarantee for precise sonodynamic therapy.

ai.title: AI Central Database
ai.subtitle: AI Central Database
ai.description: Builds a central patient-sample database from AI algorithms and individualized treatment parameters, deeply mining diagnostic data and continuously optimizing treatment parameters to provide solid data support for sonodynamic clinical research.

About.pageSubtitle: Harbin Sonuo Medical Technology Co., Ltd. — a nationally recognized high-tech enterprise focused on high-end medical equipment R&D, creator of the world's first (set) arterial plaque sonodynamic intelligent treatment system.
About.profileP1: Founded on December 3, 2020 with registered capital of ¥14.3 million, Harbin Sonuo Medical Technology Co., Ltd. is located at Unit 1, Building 4, Enterprise Accelerator, No.15199 Zhongyuan Avenue, Songbei District, Harbin. The company is a nationally recognized high-tech enterprise and a specialized & innovative SME of Heilongjiang Province, focused on the R&D, design, production, promotion and sales of high-end medical devices for sonodynamic and transcranial focused ultrasound non-invasive treatment.
About.profileP2: In December 2020, the company acquired all patents and core technologies of the "macrophage-targeted sonodynamic therapy for atherosclerotic plaque" research by Professor Tian Ye's team of Harbin Medical University through online bidding, and translated them in Harbin New Area. Relying on national major scientific research instrument projects, and in deep cooperation with Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology (CAS), the National High-performance Medical Device Innovation Center and Harbin Medical University, the company independently developed the world's first (set) "Arterial Plaque Sonodynamic Intelligent Treatment System" (MT-SDT2.0).
About.profileP3: The device is a Class III innovative medical device integrating biomedical technology and big-data AI, reported internationally for the first time, with fully independent intellectual property rights. The company holds 31 authorized patents, software copyrights and design patents, has received 13 National Natural Science Foundation grants and 2 National Support Program grants, and won the first prize of the 2021 Heilongjiang Provincial Science & Technology Award (Progress category).
